name: Stay Awake Sessions
author: Ignibyte
description: Hold the machine awake for a reason that ends by itself: a deadline, a running process, or any condition you can write as a command.

barWidget.description: What is holding the machine awake, and how long is left

schema.label: Quick hold (minutes)
schema.description: How long the one-click hold lasts.

schema.label: Quick holds, in minutes
schema.description: Up to six, comma separated. One button each in the panel.

schema.label: Quick holds, in hours
schema.description: Up to six, comma separated. One button each in the panel.

schema.label: What a hold blocks
schema.description: idle: screensaver and lock. sleep: suspend. all: both.

schema.label: Condition check interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often a process or command condition is re-checked.

schema.label: Grace period (seconds)
schema.description: How long a condition may read false before its hold ends. Covers the gap between two builds.

schema.label: Keep the icon in the bar when nothing holds
Show the time left in the bar
schema.description: Off leaves just the icon, lit while something is held.

schema.label: Notify when a hold starts
schema.description: Holds always notify when they end; this adds the other half.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: The glyph in the bar. Any character your bar font has.
